infer_device_type: infer the device type of each blob in a Caffe2 predict_net protobuf
remove_reshape_for_fc: remove reshape sub-graphs before FC operators in a Caffe2 predict_net for ONNX compatibility
fuse_copy_between_cpu_and_gpu: fuse redundant CopyCPUToGPU and CopyGPUToCPU operator pairs in a Caffe2 predict_net
remove_dead_end_ops: remove unused dead-end operators from a Caffe2 NetDef protobuf
construct_init_net_from_params: construct a Caffe2 init_net protobuf from a dictionary of parameter blobs
